text_en: A Song. A Psalm of Asaph.
O God, do not keep silence; do not hold your peace or be still, O God!
text_cn: 上主，求你不要一言不发， 天主，求你不要静默无话！

text_en: Even now your enemies are in tumult; those who hate you have raised their heads.
text_cn: 因为你的仇敌骚扰狂吼， 恼恨你的人都摇头昂首；

text_en: They lay crafty plans against your people; they consult together against those you protect.
text_cn: 相聚密谋，陷害你的百姓， 商议攻击你保护的人民，

text_en: They say, “Come, let us wipe them out as a nation; let the name of Israel be remembered no more. ”
text_cn: 说：“大家来，由万民中将他们驱散， 使以色列的名字不再被记念。”

text_en: They conspire with one accord; against you they make a covenant—
text_cn: 于是，他们心齐谋同， 缔结盟约，向你进攻，

text_en: the tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites, Moab and the Hagrites,
text_cn: 即厄东部落及依市玛耳， 又有摩阿布以及哈革尔。

text_en: Gebal and Ammon and Amalek, Philistia with the inhabitants of Tyre;
text_cn: 还有革巴耳、阿孟和阿玛肋克人， 且有培肋舍特人和提洛的居民，

text_en: Assyria also has joined them; they are the strong arm of the children of Lot. Selah
text_cn: 亚述人也与他们串通， 作了罗特子民的帮凶。 （休止）

text_en: Do to them as you did to Midian, as to Sisera and Jabin at the Wadi Kishon,
text_cn: 求你对待他们像对待米德杨人， 像在克雄河对待息色辣和雅宾，

text_en: who were destroyed at En-dor, who became dung for the ground.
text_cn: 他们都丧亡于恩多尔， 全变成了田里的粪泥，

text_en: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb, all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna,
text_cn: 使他们的王侯要与敖勒布和则厄布一样， 使他们的将领与则巴黑和匝耳慕纳一样，

text_en: who said, “Let us take the pastures of God for our own possession. ”
text_cn: 因为他们都曾如此说过： 我们去占领天主的住所。

text_en: O my God, make them like whirling dust, like chaff before the wind.
text_cn: 我的天主，求你使他们像旋风卷起的落叶， 求你使他们像狂风吹起的碎秸，

text_en: As fire consumes the forest, as the flame sets the mountains ablaze,
text_cn: 好像被火磷焚烧的树林， 又似被火焰燃烧的山陵；

text_en: so pursue them with your tempest and terrify them with your hurricane.
text_cn: 求你也这样以你的飓风驱散他们， 以你的暴雨惊吓他们。

text_en: Fill their faces with shame, so that they may seek your name, O Lord .
text_cn: 上主，求你羞辱他们的面容， 是为叫他们寻求你的圣名；

text_en: Let them be put to shame and dismayed forever; let them perish in disgrace.
text_cn: 使他们永远受辱恐慌， 叫他们个个蒙羞丧亡。

text_en: Let them know that you alone, whose name is the Lord , are the Most High over all the earth.
text_cn: 从此，认识你的名号是雅威， 惟有你在普天下至尊无对。
